ms.report:
This milestone (M3) is delivered and finalized in GitHub Release v2.0.0.Milestone Outputs
・Live Fund13 and Fund14 sections on the production portal, including listing and proposal detail views.
・Completed backend and API migration aligned with the current Catalyst / LidoNation API, with documented migration artifacts and an operational runbook.
・UI/UX adjustments implemented to maintain visual parity after the migration, documented with before/after captures.

Acceptance Criteria
AC-1: Live coverage
The verifier can open the following production URLs:
・Fund13 listing:
・https://cardanoism.com/catalyst/funds/13
・Fund14 listing:
・https://cardanoism.com/catalyst/funds/14

Each page loads successfully in production, renders at least 100 proposals per fund (±1%), and allows navigation to representative proposal detail pages.
AC-2: Backend / API migration
The backend and API migration for Fund13 and Fund14 has been completed and finalized in GitHub Release v2.0.0, anchored at the following commit:
・Repository: btbf/cardanoism
・tag: 2.0.0
・GitHub Release: v2.0.0
・Commit SHA: 749a250281798d0b54198eb3f9ac2fdec3f43f2e
・https://github.com/btbf/cardanoism/commit/749a250281798d0b54198eb3f9ac2fdec3f43f2e

The release includes:
・CHANGELOG.md describing schema and API changes for Fund13 and Fund14:
・https://github.com/btbf/cardanoism/blob/2.0.0/docs/M3/CHANGELOG.md
・Migration documentation reflecting field additions and renames.
・A reproducible data refresh procedure and operational instructions:
・https://github.com/btbf/cardanoism/blob/2.0.0/docs/M3/README.md

All artifacts explicitly reference GitHub Release v2.0.0 and the commit SHA above.
AC-3: UI / UX adjustments
UI/UX parity was maintained after the API migration.
Documented before/after screenshots and a summary of UI changes tied to the API update are provided in:
・https://github.com/btbf/cardanoism/blob/2.0.0/docs/M3/ui-diff.md

AC-4: Operational readiness
Operational readiness is fully documented and verifiable.
